set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL AND NOT KAIXA_CMAKE_DEPENDENCIES_INCLUDED)
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/KaixaDependencies.cmake")
endif()
if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
    enable_testing()
endif()

set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")

add_library(brasa_ecs STATIC
    [[brasa_ecs/brasa_ecs.hpp]]
    [[brasa_ecs/component/fwd.hpp]]
    [[brasa_ecs/entity/entity_id.hpp]]
    [[brasa_ecs/entity/fwd.hpp]]
    [[brasa_ecs/fwd.hpp]]
    [[brasa_ecs/world/fwd.hpp]]
    [[brasa_ecs/world/world.cpp]]
    [[brasa_ecs/world/world.hpp]]
)

target_include_directories(brasa_ecs PUBLIC
    "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/.>"
    [[$<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>]]
)

set_property(TARGET brasa_ecs PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")

target_compile_features(brasa_ecs PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

set_target_properties(brasa_ecs PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

install(TARGETS brasa_ecs EXPORT brasa_ecsTargets
    RUNTIME DESTINATION bin
    LIBRARY DESTINATION lib
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
    INCLUDES DESTINATION include
)

install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasa_ecs/component/fwd.hpp" DESTINATION [[include/brasa_ecs/component]])
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasa_ecs/entity/entity_id.hpp" DESTINATION [[include/brasa_ecs/entity]])
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasa_ecs/entity/fwd.hpp" DESTINATION [[include/brasa_ecs/entity]])
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasa_ecs/world/fwd.hpp" DESTINATION [[include/brasa_ecs/world]])
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasa_ecs/world/world.hpp" DESTINATION [[include/brasa_ecs/world]])
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasa_ecs/brasa_ecs.hpp" DESTINATION [[include/brasa_ecs]])
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasa_ecs/fwd.hpp" DESTINATION [[include/brasa_ecs]])

    [[brasa_ecs/world/world.test.cpp]]

    [[brasa_ecs]]

)

set_target_properties(brasa_ecs.tests PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set_target_properties(brasa_ecs.benchmarks PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

install(EXPORT brasa_ecsTargets FILE brasa_ecsTargets.cmake NAMESPACE brasa_ecs:: DESTINATION lib/cmake/brasa_ecs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
write_basic_package_version_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/brasa_ecsConfigVersion.cmake" VERSION 0.1.0 COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)

enable_testing()

include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(brasa_ecs.tests TEST_PREFIX [[brasa_ecs.tests::]] DISCOVERY_MODE PRE_TEST PROPERTIES LABELS "kaixa.target:brasa_ecs.tests\;kaixa.purpose:test")
set(_kaixa_discovery_1 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kaixa-discovery-1")
if(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_kaixa_discovery_1}-$<CONFIG>.cmake" CONTENT [=[set(_kaixa_test_executable [[$<TARGET_FILE:brasa_ecs.benchmarks>]])
set(_kaixa_test_prefix [[brasa_ecs.benchmarks]])
set(_kaixa_test_label [[kaixa.target:brasa_ecs.benchmarks;kaixa.purpose:benchmark]])
if(NOT EXISTS "${_kaixa_test_executable}")
  return()
endif()
execute_process(
  COMMAND "${_kaixa_test_executable}" [[--benchmark_list_tests=true]]
  RESULT_VARIABLE _kaixa_result
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE _kaixa_output
  ERROR_VARIABLE _kaixa_error
  OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
if(NOT _kaixa_result EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "test discovery failed: ${_kaixa_error}")

endif()
string(REPLACE "\n" ";" _kaixa_cases "${_kaixa_output}")
foreach(_kaixa_case IN LISTS _kaixa_cases)
  if(_kaixa_case STREQUAL "")
    continue()

  endif()
  set(_kaixa_name "${_kaixa_test_prefix}::${_kaixa_case}")
  add_test("${_kaixa_name}" "${_kaixa_test_executable}" [[--benchmark_filter=^${_kaixa_case}$]])
  set_tests_properties("${_kaixa_name}" PROPERTIES LABELS "${_kaixa_test_label}")
endforeach()
]=])
  file(WRITE "${_kaixa_discovery_1}.cmake" "include(\"${_kaixa_discovery_1}-\${CTEST_CONFIGURATION_TYPE}.cmake\")\n")
else()
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_kaixa_discovery_1}.cmake" CONTENT [=[set(_kaixa_test_executable [[$<TARGET_FILE:brasa_ecs.benchmarks>]])
set(_kaixa_test_prefix [[brasa_ecs.benchmarks]])
set(_kaixa_test_label [[kaixa.target:brasa_ecs.benchmarks;kaixa.purpose:benchmark]])
if(NOT EXISTS "${_kaixa_test_executable}")
  return()
endif()
execute_process(
  COMMAND "${_kaixa_test_executable}" [[--benchmark_list_tests=true]]
  RESULT_VARIABLE _kaixa_result
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE _kaixa_output
  ERROR_VARIABLE _kaixa_error
  OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
if(NOT _kaixa_result EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "test discovery failed: ${_kaixa_error}")

endif()
string(REPLACE "\n" ";" _kaixa_cases "${_kaixa_output}")
foreach(_kaixa_case IN LISTS _kaixa_cases)
  if(_kaixa_case STREQUAL "")
    continue()

  endif()
  set(_kaixa_name "${_kaixa_test_prefix}::${_kaixa_case}")
  add_test("${_kaixa_name}" "${_kaixa_test_executable}" [[--benchmark_filter=^${_kaixa_case}$]])
  set_tests_properties("${_kaixa_name}" PROPERTIES LABELS "${_kaixa_test_label}")
endforeach()
]=])
endif()
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY TEST_INCLUDE_FILES "${_kaixa_discovery_1}.cmake")
